people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”
translations.bsb: And he took all the flocks and herds, which his men drove ahead of the other livestock, calling out, “This is David’s plunder!”
translations.kjv: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.
translations.asv: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.
